title: Release supply-chain gate
description: Objective: build reproducible supported packages, lockfile integrity, signed manifests, SBOMs, vulnerability/license reports, and doctor compatibility evidence. Deliverable: release packaging pipeline at one source commit. NOT in scope: publishing a release before all gates pass. Hard dependencies: Distribution manifest packaging and supported OS conformance. Owned paths: release tooling, packaging configs, and release evidence paths. Verification: pnpm test:integration plus reproducible packaging command.
definitionOfDone: Fresh frozen-lockfile builds succeed on every supported OS with pinned engine/tool versions.
Repeated builds verify manifests/assets and record any intentionally non-reproducible platform bytes honestly.
SBOM, dependency, license, signature, and compatibility evidence binds the exact commit.
taskRails: Claims follow the benchmark permit-list; missing, partial, cross-basis, or unverifiable evidence is UNKNOWN, never PASS.
No confirmatory corpus is generated or viewed until the implementation commit is frozen exactly as specified.
GO_QUIESCE and GO_ACTIVATE are separate human decisions. Keep evidence exact, reproducible, and scoped to one source commit.

implementationPlan.description: TDD red plus pinned tooling/configuration. In package.json add exact scripts for `test:integration`, the reproducible packaging entry point, and one aggregate `verify:release` command that runs the repository-required gates, integration lane, and packaging verifier; add exact @cyclonedx/cdxgen 12.8.2 and regenerate only pnpm-lock.yaml under pnpm 11.0.8 with frozen/save-exact settings. First create tests/integration/release-supply-chain.test.mjs against the production CLI surface. Cover: source SHA differs from HEAD; Node or pnpm differs from the pins; lockfile/package manifests drift; zero packages or a silently empty generated case set; distribution signature/asset/schema/source mismatch preserving DISTRIBUTION_MISMATCH at the distribution layer; doctor incompatibility/uncertainty preserving its layer; malformed or unavailable SBOM/audit/license evidence; an unwaived HIGH/CRITICAL advisory; two equal builds; an undeclared raw-byte difference; and a difference confined to one exact declared platform field. Every refusal asserts its stable code and refusing layer, every sweep asserts a positive checked/generated count, and at least one test spawns the real CLI rather than testing a helper clone. Keep fixtures in OS temp directories and prove they are removed on success and refusal.

Make the tests green with one focused cross-platform ESM driver, scripts/release/supply-chain.mjs, kept at or below 250 physical lines. Use Node APIs and child-process argv arrays with shell:false—no bash/PowerShell syntax. The driver must: bind a 40-hex source SHA equal to HEAD; validate .node-version, packageManager/engines, current tool outputs, and the pnpm-lock/package-manifest digests; invoke the dependency's landed public distribution packaging/verifier and production doctor compatibility seam without copying their rules; package twice into isolated temp/output roots; enumerate non-empty sorted artifact paths and hash raw bytes plus embedded manifests/assets; verify signatures and manifest source/schema/tool/compatibility bindings; run the pinned CycloneDX generator, `pnpm licenses list --json`, and `pnpm audit --json` without ignore-registry-errors; and emit frozen canonical JSON evidence containing OS/arch/runner-image facts, commands and exit codes, lock/tool/source identities, raw and normalized artifact digests, SBOM/license/audit/signature/doctor report digests, and stable layer-qualified verdicts. Normalization may omit only exact declared JSON pointers/byte paths with a non-empty platform reason; retain both raw hashes and the declaration, and fail BUILD_NON_REPRODUCIBLE_UNDECLARED for every other difference. Add aggregate mode requiring exactly one Windows, Linux, and macOS receipt for the same source SHA and required evidence kinds. Reject traversal, symlink escape, huge/malformed JSON, duplicate paths, secrets in output, missing evidence, or tool/network uncertainty as stable UNKNOWN/failure; clean temp resources in finally blocks.

Add the non-publishing release workflow in .github/workflows/release-supply-chain.yml. Pin every action by full immutable commit SHA and grant only `contents: read`; use fixed supported labels windows-2025, ubuntu-24.04, and macos-15 rather than `*-latest`. Each matrix job checks out the same `${{ github.sha }}`, installs Node 24.16.0 and pnpm 11.0.8, runs `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`, proves package.json/pnpm-lock.yaml stayed unchanged, then runs the exact `pnpm verify:release` command and uploads its per-OS evidence under a source-SHA-qualified name. A required aggregate job downloads all three outputs, runs the same command in aggregate mode through environment input, asserts exactly three distinct supported OS records and one source SHA, and uploads the combined manifest. Record actual image/OS/arch/tool facts so a hosted-image patch is visible. No job may publish packages/releases, request signing secrets, generate/view confirmatory corpus, or perform GO_QUIESCE/GO_ACTIVATE; missing/cancelled/skipped matrix evidence is SUPPORTED_OS_EVIDENCE_MISSING/UNKNOWN, never PASS.

Freeze the implementation commit before release evidence. Run focused integration tests during red/green work, inspect the five owned paths only, stage each explicit file path (never git add -A, a directory pathspec, reset, stash, push, or merge), and commit the driver, workflow, test, root script/tool pin, and lockfile together. Record the resulting implementation SHA and verify the committed bytes for every owned path; if a foreign completion hook captured them first, do not rewrite history—record the exact base-ref/path diff and committed-byte hashes. Any later implementation edit invalidates release evidence and requires a new commit SHA and complete rerun. Generated SBOMs, audit reports, packages, logs, and release evidence remain outside the repository and must not be committed.

Adversarial review and mutation drill on the frozen candidate. Mutate the production driver one mechanism at a time—accept a wrong source SHA, allow an empty artifact set, ignore a distribution-layer signature refusal, treat audit-tool failure as zero advisories, broaden the normalized-difference allowlist, accept two reports instead of all three OSes, and stop binding one evidence digest. Confirm the target bytes actually changed and that the named production-surface test goes red with its specific code/layer; a syntax error or zero generated mutations is not evidence. Restore by pre-drill file SHA, not git status, and prove exact restoration. Then review output-path traversal/symlinks, command injection, credential leakage, duplicate/concurrent outputs, partial child-process writes, cleanup on signals/errors, action SHA pins/permissions, and the possibility that an OS job is skipped but aggregation still passes. If review causes an edit, create a new explicit-path commit, replace the frozen SHA, and repeat this step before verification.

Final concentrated gate; the exact verification command is `pnpm verify:release`. Record fresh foreground output and the real exit code—never pipe the gate to tail. The command must include pnpm typecheck, root tests, verify:foundation, verify:store, @moe/daemon tests, `pnpm test:integration`, and the twice-built release verifier. Run that exact command at the frozen SHA on windows-2025, ubuntu-24.04, and macos-15; then require the aggregate job to exit 0 over the three downloaded receipts. A local Windows-only green is not supported-OS evidence. Inspect the combined record mechanically: one implementation SHA; exact Node/pnpm/SBOM-tool/lockfile identities; non-empty package and checked-case counts; both raw build hashes; normalized equality or exact honest platform-difference declarations; and commit-bound SBOM, dependency, license, vulnerability, distribution signature, asset, and doctor compatibility digests. Capture repo-wide failures at merge-base and HEAD for path-attributed baseline handling, report foreign red verbatim, and complete only when owned-package legs exit 0 and the owned-path failure delta is empty. Any absent/unverifiable dependency or OS report remains UNKNOWN and blocks completion/publishing.
